settings.title: Settings
settings.urls_info_description_with_admin: Web Vault: https://{host} | Admin Panel: https://{host}/admin
settings.smarthost_active_description: Outgoing emails (invitations, 2FA, hints) are automatically routed via the NethServer 8 Smarthost ({host}).
settings.admin_password_helper: Minimum 8 characters (automatically hashed with Argon2id PHC). Leave empty to keep the existing admin password.
settings.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters long
settings.signups_domains_whitelist_helper: Comma-separated list of domains (e.g. company.de,example.org) allowed to register even when open signups are disabled.
settings.ldap_domain: LDAP / Active Directory Domain (Automatic User Invitations)
settings.no_ldap_domain: No LDAP domain (disable automatic LDAP invitations)
settings.choose_the_ldap_domain_to_invite_users: Select a NethServer 8 user domain. Domain users with an email address will be automatically invited to Vaultwarden via the vaultwarden_ldap service.
settings.ldap_sync_interval_helper: Interval between LDAP queries in seconds (minimum 60, default: 3600).
settings.ldap_search_filter_helper: Leave empty to automatically use the filter matching the NS8 domain schema (AD or RFC2307).
settings.show_password_hint: Show password hints directly on web page (not recommended)
settings.smtp_from_helper: Defaults to vaultwarden@<hostname> when using the NS8 Smarthost.
settings.push_enabled: Enable Mobile Push Notifications (Bitwarden Push Relay)
settings.push_installation_key_helper: Leave empty to keep the existing Push Installation Key.
settings.push_identity_uri_helper: Automatically switches to https://identity.bitwarden.eu when an .eu Relay URI is used.
settings.invalid_fqdn: Please enter a valid fully qualified domain name (FQDN)
settings.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address
settings.invalid_sync_interval: Sync interval must be at least 60 seconds
settings.push_credentials_required: Push Installation ID and Key are required when Push is enabled
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This domain is already configured in Traefik
